name: Exp_ColorSchaffJCCXTrendCycle
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffJCCXTrendCycle indicator, a Schaff trend cycle oscillator built on JCCX (Jurik Composite Color eXtended) with JJMA smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator color changes to bullish (above +5) and sell positions when it changes to bearish (below +2), with corresponding close signals. Position sizing is configurable via money management modes including lot-based, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorSchaffJCCXTrendCycle指标进行交易，该指标是构建在JCCX（Jurik复合彩色扩展）上的Schaff趋势周期振荡器，并使用JJMA平滑。当指标颜色变为看涨（高于+5）时开多仓，变为看跌（低于+2）时开空仓，同时发出对应的平仓信号。仓位管理支持基于手数、余额百分比和可用保证金百分比等多种模式。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Schaff趋势周期指标，该指标结合了JCCX动量振荡和JJMA自适应平滑，通过颜色变化识别趋势转折。入场条件为：当指标颜色索引从非看涨（≤5）变为看涨（>5）时开多仓，当颜色索引从非看跌（≥2）变为看跌（<2）时开空仓。出场条件为：看涨信号触发时平空仓，看跌信号触发时平多仓，同时设有止损1000点和止盈2000点。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于亏损后可用保证金、基于亏损后余额的比例计算。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1。指标使用SignalBar参数决定信号读取位置，默认为1（前一根已收盘K线），有助于避免未收盘K线的信号反复。EA还使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，防止同K线内重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Schaff Trend Cycle indicator, which combines JCCX momentum oscillation with JJMA adaptive smoothing to identify trend reversals through color changes. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator color index transitions from non-bullish (≤5) to bullish (>5), and a sell position opens when the color index transitions from non-bearish (≥2) to bearish (<2). Exit conditions: a bullish signal triggers the closing of sell positions, while a bearish signal triggers the closing of buy positions, with a stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, and percentage of balance after losses. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default risk ratio of 0.1. The indicator uses the SignalBar parameter to determine which bar to read signals from, defaulting to 1 (the last closed bar), which helps avoid signal fluctuation from unclosed bars. The EA also employs the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing repeated trades within the same bar.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比
parameters.description_en: Deposit fraction or fixed lot; negative=fixed lot

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：固定手数/余额/可用保证金等
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing mode: fixed lot/balance/free margin

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 指标计算所用价格类型

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号读取的K线索引(0=当前,1=前一根)

pros: 使用Schaff趋势周期指标，对趋势转折反应灵敏，比传统MACD信号更快
支持多种仓位计算模式，资金管理灵活，可根据账户情况选择合适的风险控制方式
设有IsNewBar新K线检测机制和SignalBar=1设置，避免未收盘K线信号反复导致的重复交易
买卖开仓和平仓均可独立开关控制，策略灵活性高
止损止盈均有参数设置，风险可控
pros_en: Uses the Schaff Trend Cycle indicator which is more responsive to trend reversals than traditional MACD signals
Supports multiple position sizing modes providing flexible money management adaptable to different account conditions
Implements IsNewBar detection and SignalBar=1 setting to avoid repeated trades from fluctuating signals on unclosed bars
Buy/sell open and close operations can each be independently enabled or disabled for high strategy flexibility
Both stop loss and take profit are parameterized, making risk controllable
cons: 完全依赖单一自定义指标，指标文件缺失时EA无法运行，且缺乏对指标失效的容错处理
止损1000点和止盈2000点对于H4周期来说数值偏大，可能造成单笔亏损过大
没有点差过滤机制，在点差较大的品种上可能因滑点造成额外损失
指标颜色索引使用硬编码阈值（5和2），不够直观且无法通过参数调整
缺乏对已有持仓数量的检查，可能在同一方向重复开仓
cons_en: Relies entirely on a single custom indicator; if the indicator file is missing the EA cannot run, and there is no fault tolerance for indicator failure
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large for the H4 timeframe, potentially causing excessive single-trade losses
No spread filter mechanism, which could lead to additional losses from slippage on high-spread instruments
Indicator color index uses hardcoded thresholds (5 and 2) which are not intuitive and cannot be adjusted via parameters
Lacks checks on existing position counts, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 增加点差过滤，当点差超过阈值时不进行交易，避免高滑点环境下入场
将颜色阈值5和2改为可配置参数，增加持仓数量检查防止同方向重复开仓
增加追踪止损功能，在盈利达到一定程度后锁定利润，而不是仅依赖固定止盈
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to prevent trading when the spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding entries in high-slippage environments
Make the color thresholds (5 and 2) configurable parameters and add position count checks to prevent duplicate openings in the same direction
Add a trailing stop feature to lock in profits after reaching a certain level, rather than relying solely on fixed take profit

risk_points: 止损1000点对于某些品种可能意味着较大资金损失，尤其是配合较大仓位时
缺乏持仓数量检查，可能在趋势持续中重复开仓导致过度暴露
依赖自定义指标，指标文件缺失或计算异常时EA行为不可预测
risk_points_en: Stop loss of 1000 points could mean significant capital loss on some instruments, especially with larger position sizes
Lack of position count checks may lead to repeated entries during sustained trends causing overexposure
Dependency on a custom indicator means unpredictable EA behavior if the indicator file is missing or calculation fails
